title: Independent focused review of fourteen proposed localization corrections
reviewer: Chat-native model independent review; not native-speaker certification
scope: Only nine CH/SHN corrected dispositions and five QUG/QUZ corrected dispositions. Conditional uncertain proposals excluded. No production edits or tests.
method: Read exact English, candidate, proposed correction and prior reasoning; independently assessed meaning and morphology. Did not require published UI sentences. Narrow lexical checks do not substitute for whole-message judgment.

entries.previous_reason: Replace maseha (even/although/any) with an explicit minimum quantity, putlumenus; one or more, not an arbitrary single image.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. The command and noun phrase remain coherent; putlumenus establishes a minimum of one. Maseha did not reliably express that quantitative constraint.

entries.previous_reason: Tinekcha' is fruit, not height. Attura denotes height; preserve the unit argument.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Attura corrects the dimension noun: Tinekcha' was not height. Unit placeholder unchanged.

entries.previous_reason: Tinekcha' is fruit. Replace only the dimension noun with height and retain the unit relation.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Same substantive dimension correction; gi supplies the relation to the measurement unit.

entries.previous_reason: Tinekcha' siha means fruits, not heights. Retain plural siha.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Height noun plus plural siha denotes multiple heights rather than fruits.

entries.previous_reason: Orifinåt is not the original adjective; use urihinåt with the size noun.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Urihinåt supplies original, na links the modifier, and mineddong denotes size; repairs malformed original adjective.

entries.original_candidate: ၵၢၼ်တင်ႈၶႃႈ
entries.previous_reason: Remove the anomalous ၶႃႈ; the simple settings noun is supported by SIIT's own computing instructions.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Nominalized setting expression works as menu label; ၶႃႈ is an inappropriate attached politeness particle, not necessary settings morphology.

entries.english: Android could not find a file picker. Enable the Files or Documents app in Android settings, then try again.
entries.original_candidate: Android ႁႃတူဝ်လိူၵ်ႈၾၢႆႇဢမ်ႇႁၼ်။ ပိုတ်ႇၸႂ်ႉဢႅပ်ႉ Files ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် Documents ၼႂ်းၵၢၼ်တင်ႈၶႃႈ Android၊ ယဝ်ႉၸၢမ်းထႅင်ႈၵမ်းၼိုင်ႈ။
entries.proposed_correction: Android ႁႃတူဝ်လိူၵ်ႈၾၢႆႇဢမ်ႇႁၼ်။ ပိုတ်ႇၸႂ်ႉဢႅပ်ႉ Files ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် Documents ၼႂ်းၵၢၼ်တင်ႈ Android၊ ယဝ်ႉၸၢမ်းထႅင်ႈၵမ်းၼိုင်ႈ။
entries.previous_reason: Correct settings noun only; retain missing picker, enable action, both app names, then retry in order.
entries.final_wording: Android ႁႃတူဝ်လိူၵ်ႈၾၢႆႇဢမ်ႇႁၼ်။ ပိုတ်ႇၸႂ်ႉဢႅပ်ႉ Files ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် Documents ၼႂ်းၵၢၼ်တင်ႈ Android၊ ယဝ်ႉၸၢမ်းထႅင်ႈၵမ်းၼိုင်ႈ။
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Removes intrusive particle in settings phrase. Whole instruction preserves failure to find picker, enable Files or Documents in Android settings, then retry.

entries.proposed_correction: လိူၵ်ႈႁၢင်ႈၼိုင်ႈႁၢင်ႈ ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် လိူဝ်ၼၼ်ႉ။
entries.previous_reason: ယၢမ်ႈ is accustomed/ever, not minimum. Explicit one image or more avoids the false minimum expression.
entries.final_wording: လိူၵ်ႈႁၢင်ႈၼိုင်ႈႁၢင်ႈ ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် လိူဝ်ၼၼ်ႉ။
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Coherent choose-one-image-or-more formulation expresses minimum, unlike mistaken accustomed/ever component in ယၢမ်ႈသုတ်း.

entries.english: Trim amounts must be zero or greater.
entries.original_candidate: ၸမ်းတတ်းၼၼ်ႉ တေလႆႈပဵၼ်သုၼ် ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် ယႂ်ႇလိူဝ်သုၼ်။
entries.proposed_correction: တၢင်းၼမ်ဢၼ်တေတတ်းဢွၵ်ႇ တေလႆႈပဵၼ်သုၼ် ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် ယႂ်ႇလိူဝ်သုၼ်။
entries.previous_reason: ၸမ်းတတ်း does not clearly express amounts to trim. Replacement explicitly says the amount to cut off must be zero or greater; preserves inclusive zero.
entries.final_wording: တၢင်းၼမ်ဢၼ်တေတတ်းဢွၵ်ႇ တေလႆႈပဵၼ်သုၼ် ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် ယႂ်ႇလိူဝ်သုၼ်။
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Subject explicitly names amount to cut off; obligation includes zero or greater than zero. Does not exclude zero or command trimming to zero.

entries.previous_reason: Use the adjective Raku for a standalone Bold style label; Rakuta bears an unnecessary object/adverbial -ta here. Typographic thickness metaphor is reasonable.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Thick is a workable typographic style label. Bare adjective suits label better than Rakuta, though the latter is not ungrammatical in every construction.

entries.previous_reason: Remove duplicated -ta in kikinllatata. This is a bounded morphological correction, not certification of the phrase as conventional clipboard Copy.
entries.independent_reason: Accept as descriptive wording. Removes duplicated -ta. Remaining expression coherently directs making the same/reproducing. Lower idiomatic confidence; no claim this is the preferred established clipboard term.

entries.previous_reason: Remove duplicated -ta in kikinllatata; preserve all. Clipboard terminology remains a usage question.
entries.independent_reason: Accept as descriptive wording. Removes duplicated -ta within kikinllatata and retains all. The -ta on Tukuyta and in kikinllata perform separate roles. Lower idiomatic confidence; no claim of preferred established clipboard terminology.

entries.previous_reason: Remove the Southern-style ejective apostrophe for the stated Ecuadorian Kichwa orthography. This is not a change to Southern Lluq'i.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Ecuadorian Kichwa spelling removes ejective marker imported from another orthographic/phonological system; no reason to substitute Southern Lluq'i.

entries.previous_reason: Mark the full object with -ta, consistently with Llapanta akllay and Llapanta rikuchiy already used in this catalogue.
entries.independent_reason: Accept. Explicitly marks all as object of clearing. Original bare Llapan might admit elliptical reading; correction is preferable without declaring all bare-object constructions impossible.
